diagnosis: The viewset queries GenericActivityLog using the model and object_id query parameters without verifying whether request.user has permission to view the referenced object. Any user can enumerate activity logs, actor IDs, status changes, and sensitive state transitions of restricted resources such as SalaryReview or InternalInvestigation.
exploit_request:
GET /api/generic/audit-logs/?model=salaryreview&object_id=94 HTTP/1.1
Host: hr-portal.internal
Authorization: Bearer <regular_employee_token>
